facts.fact: PCH's Internet Exchange Directory lists CV-IXP (Associação Cabo Verde Internet Exchange Point) in Praia as an Active Ethernet exchange established 29 November 2022; the record lists no switches, facilities or participants, and the page has no date of its own so the established date is used.

facts.fact: PeeringDB lists CV-IXP in Praia with 5 peers (Banco Caboverdiano de Negocios, CV Telecom, NOSi EPE, UNITEL T and the CV-IXP route servers), 6 connections and 23G total capacity; the document is dated 2024 only to the year.

facts.fact: The Cabo Verde government's own status booklet states that it has introduced the IXP (Internet Exchange Point), with the effect of lowering costs and latency and improving internet quality; no exchange name, city or member count is given and no event date is given, so as_of is the document's published date (2026-04).
Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker lists 1 active exchange point in Cabo Verde with 5 members as of November 2026.
